crossRefs.note: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?
But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.

translations.web: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
translations.bsb: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.
